title: Entitlement field vocabulary
description: Shapes shared by every message that names an entitlement field: the manifest declares fields, and desired, observed and state carry their values.

FieldType.description: The shape Syndra must supply for a field, as the manifest declares it.

FieldValue.description: One field's value: a list of strings, a boolean, an integer or a string. Which one applies to a given field is stated by its entry in the manifest's entitlement_schema.

FieldValues.description: Entitlement field values keyed by field name. Absent and empty differ: an absent key is unmanaged, an empty value is 'make it empty'.

ReportedValues.description: Entitlement field values as an add-on reports them (state, observed). Unlike desired, a list-valued field may be null: today's add-on reports an account with no groups as null, not []. Contract 2 emits [] (addon-contract tasks, slice 1).
